_about: Public-domain James H. McConkey, American Bible teacher, for the Word Hoard: The Threefold Secret of the Holy Spirit, The End of the Age, Believing is Seeing, Prayer, The Surrendered Life, Life Talks, and The Book of Revelation. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 130 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
